problem_type: Ambient executable lookup selects an incompatible archive implementation
symptom: Five complete installer class tests fail with GNU tar interpreting a Windows C: archive path as a remote host.
direct_cause: extractArchive spawns the bare tar name; Git usr/bin before System32 selects GNU tar, which does not provide the promised ZIP extraction contract.
class_root: The target-platform archive contract is not bound to the system bsdtar implementation the installer requires.
affected_population: Windows installations with Git or other tar ahead in PATH
macOS installations with a different tar ahead in PATH

external_sources.purpose: Windows ships libarchive bsdtar supporting ZIP extraction; bind that implementation rather than an incompatible PATH tool.

invariants: ZIP extraction uses the supported OS bsdtar, independent of ambient PATH.
Missing or invalid native executable configuration fails visibly; no alternate archive engine or unchecked fallback.
Existing archive/member/weight hashes and atomic publication remain mandatory.

door_reduction.why_not: The one install owner invokes the extractor for every supported engine archive.

generality_proof: Explicit target-native archive selection prevents PATH drift across every installed engine/member population without a model/provider exception.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Invoke the supported native ZIP extractor before member verification and atomic publication.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All supported engine installation reaches extractArchive.
Readiness invokes the same engine installer; member/weight/VAD failures remain tested.

recurrence.reason: Any supported machine with a different tar earlier in PATH selects incompatible semantics.
same_class_scan: Compared Windows System32 bsdtar 3.8.9 with Git GNU tar failure under identical ZIP fixtures
Inspected all supported engine platform declarations and archive install callers

prevention.invariant: Only the native supported bsdtar owns ZIP extraction.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported target or missing Windows root/executable reports install failure; no silent alternate tool.
prevention.strategy: Resolve the system archive executable at the existing extractor boundary; preserve all verified cache/member publication checks.

legacy_paths.rationale: Ambient bare tar lookup is replaced; no second extraction implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.current: Windows system bsdtar 3.8.9; macOS system bsdtar
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Use the existing system archive library required by repository design; no new unzip implementation or dependency.
exit_criteria: Revisit when shipped engine archive format or supported OS targets change; rerun real archive/member verification tests.

migration: No installed speech assets, user preferences, permissions or project data are changed by this source repair.
residual_risks: macOS path selection is covered by fixtures; native macOS execution is not available on this host.
